title: Yellow Gigantes Stew
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew made with yellow gigantes beans and a medley of vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes, soaked and drained yellow gigantes beans, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or lemon wedges, if desired.
